title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body: Seriously dude how many times are you gonna post this, nothings gonna happen unless you sit down and write these out and actually try to make them happen. You’re not an aspiring writer-director unless you’re actively doing those things

On one hand, all ideas are great. The litmus is in the writing.  From a more writerly view, your log lines here could use some tuning up, i.e. some passive verbs and adjectives are not helping. From a conceptual angle, I have questions: elephants and autism?? I can see people getting triggered.  A Rabbit Hole in Wonderland -- both somewhat overused and a long title for a movie. I also suspect that producers would balk at something referencing classic poems (nobody knows what they even are anymore let alone being able to see the connection because they haven't read any.)
